correctness.rationale: Proof: primitive continuant induction gives geometrically prime block determinants; diagonal adjugate entries exclude accidental singularities; nonzero-edge path blocks have nullity at most one; two singular blocks force a cut and give the complete reduced locus. Reduced component ideals after any cut set reduce to first/last block determinants and independent cut equations, proving prime complete intersections and degrees. Explicit rational transverse slices have exact determinant ir(uv-w^2). Hypersurface S2 plus codimension-2 singular locus proves normality. Exact checker independently confirms finite examples and identities; no finite data used to prove generality.

The new statement is the exact reduced decomposition for a free-edge symmetric path and all subset intersection prime ideals, degrees and ordinary transverse nodes. Residual implicit/unindexed coverage remains possible.

value.rationale: The complete singular-support arrangement of a natural infinite family of sparse symmetric determinant hypersurfaces is a geometrically motivated classification. It determines every component and arbitrary intersection as a reduced irreducible complete intersection, including exact dimensions, degrees and generic analytic types. This is information not contained in the general rank-drop degree or continuant recurrence. It informs degenerations of continuant hypersurfaces and potential resolutions without claiming those downstream results.
